name: ludo-royale
description: Ludo Royale: online multiplayer Ludo for friends and colleagues.

scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p server/test && tsc -p web && tsc -p web/test
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c server/wrangler.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy -c server/wrangler.jsonc
